title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a cumin-and-smoked-paprika tomato sauce, finished with feta and herbs. Garlic-rubbed sourdough for dipping.
source: Cody's Claude chat ('Take on the role of a chef'), imported 2026-09-20

steps.text: Heat {oil} in a 10 to 12 inch skillet over medium. Add {onion} and {pepper}, diced, and cook 5 to 7 minutes until soft and starting to brown.
steps.why: Caramelization is the flavor base of the whole dish — rushed pale onions make a flat sauce.

steps.text: Add {garlic}, minced, and cook 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant, not browned.
Add {cumin}, {paprika}, {coriander}, and {cayenne}. Stir 30 seconds in the hot pan.
steps.why: Blooming spices in hot oil releases their aromatic oils — raw spices dumped into liquid stay dusty and muted.

steps.text: Pour in {tomatoes}, add {sugar}, season with salt and pepper, and simmer 10 to 15 minutes until slightly thickened. Taste and correct.
steps.why: The sauce must be fully seasoned before the eggs go in — there's no fixing it after.

steps.text: Drop the heat to low. Make wells in the sauce, crack each egg into a cup, and slide into a well. Cover and cook 7 to 10 minutes until whites are set and yolks still runny.
steps.why: Low heat and a lid set the whites gently with trapped steam — hard simmering makes rubbery whites and blown-out yolks.

steps.text: Meanwhile, toast {bread} at 400°F for 5 to 7 minutes, rub with the cut garlic clove while hot, drizzle with olive oil and salt.
steps.why: Hot bread absorbs the garlic's flavor from a single swipe — cold toast just gets scratched.

steps.text: Scatter {feta} and the herbs over the pan and bring it to the table on a trivet. Serve immediately.
steps.why: The eggs keep cooking in the hot sauce — every minute of waiting costs runny yolk.

notes.title: Make-ahead
notes.body: The sauce alone keeps 3 to 4 days refrigerated. Reheat and poach fresh eggs in it each time — cooked eggs reheat with hard yolks.

plating: Straight from the pan on a trivet. Scoop egg, sauce, and toppings onto plates; tear and dip the sourdough — runny yolk mixing with tomato sauce into the bread is the whole dish.
elevations: Crumbled chorizo or merguez browned with the onions.
A spoon of harissa in the sauce for depth and heat.
Chickpeas or wilted spinach folded in before the eggs.
variations: Za'atar butter on the bread instead of the garlic rub.
